title: RemoteFunction.OnClientInvoke
summary: The client-assigned handler answering InvokeClient calls from the server. Set it BEFORE the server might invoke; keep responses honest-but-untrusted from the server's perspective.

reference.signature: RemoteFunction.OnClientInvoke = function(...args: any) ... return value end

details.heading: No player parameter
details.body: The client already knows who it is; the handler receives only the server's arguments.

details.heading: If unset
details.body: An InvokeClient to this client fails/times out on the server. Set the handler early.

explanation.whatItIs: The client's side of the rare server→client question.
whenToUse: Answering genuinely client-known facts the server asks for (with server-side timeouts)
whenNotToUse: As a security channel — the server should never depend on client answers for authority
If the flow can be inverted to client-initiated (usually it can)
tips: Set it in client boot before gameplay begins
commonMistakes: Never setting it while the server invokes → server errors/timeouts
Returning heavy tables every time — keep responses small

examples.title: Answering the server
examples.code:
-- LocalScript:
local rf = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("ClientQuery")

rf.OnClientInvoke = function(question)
    if question == "SelectedSlot" then
        return selectedSlot or 1
    end
    return nil
end
